findings.title: Pins go stale after a sibling release; init installs older packages and offers to downgrade newer ones
findings.label: match
findings.note: Identifies that pins go stale after sibling-only releases and that the !== skew check offers to downgrade newer installs, which is KD-1.

findings.title: An embedded pin names a version that is not installable from npm
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The build-before-publish embed can name a version that never reached npm, and exact pins then fail to install; plausible, and not KD-1.
